name: portal-raphael-lima
description: Portal Raphael Lima — monorepo por pastas (apps/web e apps/api), sem workspaces

scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir apps/api install && pnpm --dir apps/web install
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir apps/api typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
